# Saved-state compatibility fixture

`v0.1.0-hot-state.json` was generated by the unmodified engine and physics modules at commit `fede82c6d6846e4e88636418c321320d5a1cd348` (release v0.1.0):

```js
const plant = new PWRPlant();
plant.setControl('demand', 0.75);
plant.step(60);
const fixture = plant.exportState();
```

It is an actual v1-format state during a transient. It is not a v2 state with its schema label changed. Migration checks use it to detect compatibility regressions. Changed physical closures can alter subsequent results; migration preserves the saved dynamic state rather than promising bit-identical continuation across model versions.
